about: The universal world generator schema (docs/v2/models-and-settings.md §4; milestones M8a). Every number and rule the world generator, the laws, the smoother, crowds and the director used to keep in code, with its default (today's value), unit, range, meaning, where it is used and which layers may override it: defaults < a universe's universe/settings.json < a book's stage/settings.json < a place's own (places.<id> in either). kind: hard (a gate or limit), knob (a choice of taste or calibration), physics (a measured constant), structure (the grid itself; changing it changes everything), presentation (what Jev or the viewer is shown). Tables are whole files, merged key by key over their defaults. Read through src/v2/settings.ts setting(key, scope). Infinity is written "Infinity".

grid.cell.meaning: The walk grid's cell: every place is built and walked on 2 m squares.

grid.floor.meaning: One storey: a floor's height and the walk grid's vertical step.

body.height.meaning: A person's height, the one human scale kept (physics-laws.md §9).

fill.streets.meaning: The city fill's street net and lots: super-block cell, arterial, collector and local road widths, block area and least block side, small and large lot areas.

fill.buildingArea.meaning: A building's footprint range by its type.

fill.ops.meaning: What a place's fill scatters besides its buildings (trees, street lights, benches, bins, parked cars, bollards, or any kind of your own that fill.props connects a part to): a list of operators scatter (on open ground, along streets, in plazas), line (along roads of a level, every so many metres) and ring (round a point); never inside a building or on a carriageway.

fill.props.meaning: Which warehouse part draws each kind of street furniture the fill operators put down: the six built in (tree, street-light, bench, bin, car, bollard), or any kind of your own (wind-turbine, lantern) that a fill operator names in its `what`: a map kind -> <source>:<part> (novel warehouse find|use); a built-in kind with none is drawn as its plain shape, a kind of your own with none is not drawn.

landscape.peak.meaning: The tallest any building may be: a merge may lift a building past its type's cap, never past this.

landscape.slender.meaning: How many times its footprint's width a building may be tall.

landscape.superTall.meaning: A skyscraper core whose mean height reaches this widens its plots and streets for the towers.

landscape.square.meaning: A square's open middle: a share of its radius, kept between least and most.

landscape.clear.meaning: How far the city's lots keep from a compound (a centre's podium and plaza, a station's hall).

landscape.lane.meaning: The back lane between a street's rows behind its frontage.

landscape.groundByScale.meaning: The ground a scale suggests when nothing larger has a landscape.

layers.floor.meaning: Where the deep underground, the air layer and space begin.

layers.room.meaning: The room a virtual layer gives a place.

layers.skin.meaning: The ground skin over a street laid underground.

tall.from.meaning: Above this a building is as thick as its height needs (no side under height / slender); the tallest grown first.

tall.around.meaning: How tall buildings press the ones around them: reach, per, most.

underground.bands.meaning: The ground in three bands by depth: unsupported span, what breaks it, its arch and bulk when it falls.

underground.lining.meaning: A reinforced lining's added span and bond; a pillar's bond.

underground.intervals.meaning: The depth intervals Jev picks underground from: just under the street, the subway, deep.

underground.hallHeight.meaning: A hall's height by its kind.

underground.beamBore.meaning: How deep a beam bores through the ground before the rock stops it.

place.least.meaning: The least radius of a place of each scale before anything is built in it.

place.gap.meaning: The gap kept between sibling places on the canvas.

place.poolSpacing.meaning: How far apart a pool keeps its members, by their kind.

spawn.layout.meaning: How a parent's manifolds lie: cover, blend at fading edges, how far a standing one may move, the objective's weights.

spawn.heightLimit.meaning: How far one spawn may lower a part (and a damaged part), as a share of its average.

spawn.typeSure.meaning: When a building's type is sure from the inventory: Jev's lead, or words with a lead.

spawn.slots.meaning: Borrowing's objective: ties across parents, and the pull toward a pin.

spawn.floatMass.meaning: How hard a place holds still when the float relaxes: unnamed, a slot, named.

view.half.meaning: How far a parent's picture for Jev reaches, by its scale.

view.core.meaning: The core the terrain-height question looks through: a share of the highest slice, at least least.

view.impactSizes.meaning: The sizes Jev picks an impact from.

view.props.unit: metres and hex colour per prop kind
view.props.meaning: How each kind of street furniture is drawn when it has no warehouse part (fill.props): the plain shape's height in metres and its colour; a part in kit units is scaled to this height.

buildings.roleOf.meaning: A named building kind's role in the world.

buildings.floorsOf.meaning: Floors of a named building by its kind (stage architecture).

buildings.worldFirst.meaning: A world-first spot's building: its role and floors.

walk.factors.meaning: Edge-cost factors by way [walk, climb, descend, jump, fall, sky arc]: a fall is cheap only for someone falling.

walk.mannerSpeed.meaning: The hologram navigator's speed by manner.

roads.waits.meaning: The wait at a crossing with lights (signal) and at a T (give way).

roads.junction.meaning: Road ends closer than this are one junction.

highway.knobs.meaning: The expressway: curve radius, deck half width and height, tunnel depth, ramp length, half width, offset and spacing, growth beta ratio, story share of a hub's mass, a gate's least mass, the ramps' pull on buildings and its reach.

highway.cost.meaning: Building the expressway, per metre, by what lies under it (a lot: base + steep × √(min(1, H / height))), plus travel; a tunnel per metre and a portal at each end.

laws.speed.meaning: Speeds by way for the travel-time law (L5).

laws.transit.meaning: The virtual public transport: access run, wait, ride speed; a metro within a city, rail beyond.

talk.live.meaning: Face to face: the distance of a live talk (L6).

talk.earshot.meaning: A voice everyone around hears: public talk (L6); those within it at a scene start stand together.

laws.perCell.meaning: People who may share a 2 m cell before it is a crowd (L11).

laws.person.meaning: What a person can do without an ability or a weapon: a fist's reach, a throw's range.

smoother.rankSigma.meaning: How sure a position is by its rank (σ).

smoother.walk.meaning: The smoother's talk σ, step, scene gap, cloud size and kept spots.
used: world-engine/smoother/smoother.mjs TALK_SIGMA STEP SCENE_GAP CLOUD KEEP

smoother.revisionLimit.meaning: The most a scene start may move before the revision goes to the review.

smoother.livePrior.meaning: A line whose kind no one gave: face to face this likely.

occupation.hmm.meaning: Who is on the stage: detection, false alarm, staying on, entering, first appearance.
used: world-engine/smoother/occupation.mjs ETA FALSE_ALARM STAY ENTER FIRST

occupation.likelihood.meaning: How much each kind of mention says someone is there.

crowd.ring.meaning: Where a gathering crowd holds from its focus (Hall's public distance).

crowd.weidmann.meaning: Weidmann's fundamental diagram: free speed, jam density, gamma.

crowd.density.meaning: People a square metre for a crowd's size (Fruin's levels of service).

crowd.motion.meaning: Each crowd state's pace against walking, how much people follow, and noise.

crowd.samples.meaning: The most samples a crowd is drawn with (a drawing budget).

director.moveSure.meaning: The digest's moves played when at least this sure.

director.factSearch.meaning: How far the layout artist and the checks look for a spot that agrees with the notes.

director.underSearch.meaning: How far round a unit's start a spot under the street is looked for.

director.crowdReach.meaning: The widest a crowd's field reaches round its anchor (W13's scene 249 crash).

director.aroundMost.meaning: The widest window a look round a point builds (W13's crash).

replay.clock.meaning: A card lasts long enough to read its lines (say seconds a character, read at least); moves play demo× life.

replay.pace.meaning: The player's walking and running paces, and the slowest a paced piece goes.

replay.smooth.meaning: Smooth mode: the camera's averaging window either side, the handover between groups, a walk's speed ramp.

models.nominate.meaning: Which things get a model of their own: seen in at least ownScenes scenes or named in at least ownMentions sentences (a kind that can have one), at most top a book; the rest bind to a warehouse part.

models.contract.meaning: The contract a model is checked against: its lowest point within max(ground, groundShare × its height) of z = 0; every piece within max(touch, touchShare × its longest side) of the body (else it floats); its longest side within sizeFactor of the reading's; at most triangles; written in at most tries; at most primitives shapes and $fn.

models.vehicles.meaning: Which warehouse part draws a vehicle of each kind (a car, a van or a truck, a bus, a train or a carriage, a motorbike or a bicycle, a boat, a helicopter, an aircraft, a drone) when the thing has no model of its own: a map kind -> <source>:<part>; else the transport specialist's pick among the baked cars, else the page's form from parts.

models.parts.meaning: Which warehouse part a thing of each kind is bound to by novel model bind before the work model is asked (a small weapon, a handheld thing, a bag or a box, and any kind the nomination gives a part): a map kind -> <source>:<part>.

models.halls.meaning: Which model dresses each kind of underground hall on the terrain stage (corridor, tunnel, station, utility, mall, shelter): a baked model's name or a warehouse part <source>:<part>; a kind with none is drawn as its plain box.

models.vehicleWords.meaning: Which baked model (or warehouse part) a vehicle of a kind is drawn as, by the words of its name, before the built-in rules (taxi, police, ambulance, fire, truck): { "<kind>": { "<regex over the name>": "<model or part>" } }; checked in order, the first match wins. Empty: the built-in rules alone.

terrain.landscapes.meaning: Each landscape and street kind: hint, era, sizes, heights, lots, blocks, coverage, setback, shape, and which building a lot of so many floors is (steps).

terrain.buildingTypes.meaning: Building types: words, uses and what each is.

terrain.city.meaning: What a city of each kind spawns (districts) and how they lie.

terrain.district.meaning: What a district of each kind spawns (streets).

terrain.street.meaning: A street kind's buildings: density and uses.

terrain.heights.meaning: Every building type's least floors and each area kind's least median, a hard gate.

terrain.composite.meaning: A building's tenants by floor (composite buildings).

models.uses.meaning: Which model stands for each use, kind and role; old-world models only on ancient ground.

models.furniture.meaning: Each room kind's furniture as rules from the walls in (wall, grid, centre, around, back, corner, row, stools): the furniture kit's model names, by room type (the architect's rooms, digest/rooms.mjs).

grid.after: Everything is rebuilt and every kept node id moves: not settable.

fill.about: The city fill: streets, blocks, lots, footprints.
fill.after: The world built for a run (the fill, its buildings, the walk graph): takes effect at the next run or rehearsal; no Jev question is asked again.

landscape.about: Landscape and street kinds, their limits and their open ground.
landscape.after: The world built for a run (the fill, its buildings, the walk graph): takes effect at the next run or rehearsal; no Jev question is asked again.

layers.about: The deep underground, the air layer and space.
layers.after: The world built for a run (the fill, its buildings, the walk graph): takes effect at the next run or rehearsal; no Jev question is asked again.

tall.after: The world built for a run (the fill, its buildings, the walk graph): takes effect at the next run or rehearsal; no Jev question is asked again.

underground.about: The ground in depth bands, halls and what bores through it.
underground.after: The world built for a run (the fill, its buildings, the walk graph): takes effect at the next run or rehearsal; no Jev question is asked again. Jev’s depth answers are kept.

place.about: Places on the canvas before anything is built.
place.after: Terrain spawning (novel sim terrain <novel> --spawn --from <level> --run) uses them when it places areas: rerun spawning from the level they touch; the world built from kept terrain does not change.

view.about: What Jev is shown when asked.
view.after: The next question of that kind; answers already kept are not asked again.

buildings.after: The world built for a run (the fill, its buildings, the walk graph): takes effect at the next run or rehearsal; no Jev question is asked again.

walk.after: The world built for a run (the fill, its buildings, the walk graph): takes effect at the next run or rehearsal; no Jev question is asked again.

roads.after: The next director run (the road graph is built for each run).

highway.after: The expressway is laid once by the terrain’s transport step and kept: rerun node world-engine/terrain/transport.mjs <novel> --rebuild for knobs and cost; the ramps’ pull on buildings applies at the next run.

laws.after: The laws’ verdicts at the next director run, and the smoother after it.

talk.after: The laws, the director’s gathering and the smoother at the next run.

smoother.after: The smoother after the next run.

occupation.about: Who is on the stage (the smoother’s occupation).
occupation.after: The smoother after the next run.

director.about: The director’s own reaches and thresholds.

replay.after: The director’s card timing at the next run; the player keeps its own copies (not wired yet).

models.after: The next novel model nominate or write; models already made are kept.
